name: Infinite Babel
purpose: A deterministic infinite library in the style of libraryofbabel.info: every hex address maps to a stable, generated 4100-character page. No page content is ever stored — the address is the only datum; the page is derived from it on every read.

entities.name: Page
relationships: has exactly one canonical hex address
content is derived deterministically from the address (never stored)

workflows.name: View a page by address
workflows.description: open /books/:hex and receive the generated 4100-character page with its address shown

workflows.name: Navigate neighbors
workflows.description: previous/next links move through hex address +/- 1; any address is valid

workflows.name: Random page
workflows.description: generates a random hex address and redirects to its page

workflows.name: Search the library
workflows.description: bounded deterministic scan from a start address for an exact phrase; returns the first page containing it or reports not found in the scanned window

seed_demo: Nothing to seed — the library generates itself from addresses. A small curated vault of recovered texts at low addresses (e.g. 1, 2, 3) makes phrase-search demos land instantly.
